availability_audit: Cap 76 (C39 Scorched Slab grants it; C40 and C41 change nothing; C42 the Space Center grants 84). Chronology against pool-76.json source_detail, all upstream of Route 128: Incineroar gate 36 (Litten, Mauville Game Corner; level evolutions). Rillaboom gate 36 (Grookey, same). Urshifu-Single gate 42 (Kubfu, legendary_sign:Route112, the Jagged Pass approach used for the Magma Emblem). Amoonguss gate 42 (Foongus, Petalburg Woods). Metagross gate 48 (Beldum/Metang line) with ITEM_METAGROSSITE stone-window 42. Volcanion gate 68, legendary_sign:MagmaHideout_4F - C38 Magma Hideout and Groudon precede C40's Aqua Hideout and C41 Mossdeep in the book's own chapter order, so a player standing on Route 128 has cleared it. Nothing from Mossdeep, the Space Center, Shoal Cave, the Abandoned Ship, Seafloor Cavern, Sootopolis, Route 131 or Pacifidlog.
reachable_legends: Two: Urshifu-Single (via Kubfu, gate 42) and Volcanion (gate 68, a Mythical). Volcanion is here because it is the honest strongest answer to this specific encounter, not as a general upgrade - Fire/Water is simultaneously 4x into Technician Scizor and 2x into Mega Diancie's Rock half, and no non-legendary body in the cap-76 pool covers both of Alexa's two best Pokemon in one slot. Attempt 1 lost precisely because I had neither a Water nor a Steel answer to Mega Diancie and lost my only Fire body before Scizor arrived.
plan: Built from the dossier's own crack line after attempt 1. Four changes from the sea-routes six. (1) Knock Off stays and leads: it stripped Marowak-Alola's Thick Club on turn 1 of attempt 1 for 226 damage on a 264 HP body, which is the single most valuable action available in this fight. (2) Mega Metagross replaces Mega Gardevoir: Meteor Mash is Steel, 2x into Mega Diancie, Bullet Punch answers Scizor's priority with priority, and a Steel body resists the Technician Bullet Punch that killed three of my Pokemon last time. (3) Volcanion replaces Zapdos: Steam Eruption is 2x into Diancie and Flamethrower is 4x into Scizor, where Zapdos's Thunderbolt was 0.5x into Ampharos and its Heat Wave 0.5x into Diancie - Zapdos contributed almost nothing. (4) Rillaboom's High Horsepower is kept deliberately: Ground is 2x into both Ampharos and Diancie. Amoonguss keeps Spore, but note Mega Diancie's Magic Bounce returns it, so sleep must be aimed at anything else.
